title: Beanz pizza (dough above)
ingredients: 1 pre-made pizza crust (or homemade if you prefer)
1/2 cup of grated mozzarella (maybe get a pizza mix)
1/4 cup of chopped green bell pepper
1/4 cup of chopped cooked bacon or ham (optional)
instructions: Spread the beanz sauce on the crust
Spread the beans evenly over the pre-made pizza crust.
Add the chopped red onion, green bell pepper, and cooked bacon or ham (if using) on top of the beans.
Sprinkle the grated cheese over the vegetables and beans.
Season the pizza with dried oregano, salt, and pepper.
Bake the pizza in the oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the crust is crispy.
Slice the pizza into wedges and serve hot.
